site-prep.label: Site prep (clearing, layout, erosion control, temporary power)
site-prep.source: Judgment based on typical GC general-conditions budgets for a flat suburban Treasure Valley lot
site-prep.note: Per house. Includes survey staking, silt fence/SWPPP, temp power pole, portable toilet and dumpster setup for ~6-9 months. Wooded or foothill lots higher. Full price: usually hired out as a whole job.
site-prep.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

excavation.label: Digging and hauling dirt
excavation.source: Judgment based on Boise excavation sub pricing (equipment + trucking, dump fees as material)
excavation.note: Equipment, operator time, dump fees and fuel. Basalt/caliche or rock in the foothills can double the high end. Full price: usually hired out as a whole job.
excavation.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

backfill-grade.label: Backfill and finish grading
backfill-grade.source: Judgment based on typical excavation sub pricing; per sqft of building footprint
backfill-grade.note: Backfill around foundation with native soil, compaction, rough and finish grade to drain away from house. Imported fill or topsoil pushes toward high. Full price: usually hired out as a whole job.
backfill-grade.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

driveway.label: Concrete driveway
driveway.note: 4-5 in broom-finish concrete on compacted gravel.
driveway.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

drainage-some.label: Drainage work (swales, downspout lines)
drainage-some.source: Judgment based on typical landscape/excavation sub bids
drainage-some.note: Shaped swales plus ~100-200 ft of solid downspout drain line to daylight or drywell. Full price: usually hired out as a whole job.
drainage-some.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

drainage-major.label: Major drainage work (French drains, sump, grading)
drainage-major.source: Judgment based on typical excavation/drainage sub bids for poorly draining lots
drainage-major.note: French drain around foundation, sump basin + pump, drywell(s), extra grading. Ada County requires on-site stormwater retention (drywells/seepage beds) on many lots. Full price: usually hired out as a whole job.
drainage-major.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

retaining-wall.label: Retaining wall (concrete/block)
retaining-wall.source: Judgment based on national retaining-wall cost guides ($30-$90/sqft face installed)
retaining-wall.note: Segmental block or poured concrete, under ~4 ft without engineering. Taller engineered walls (foothills) exceed high. Split ~40/60.
retaining-wall.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

rock-removal.label: Big rock removal (break up and haul)
rock-removal.source: Judgment based on national boulder and rock removal guides (about $75-$250 per cubic yard with a breaker and haul-off)
rock-removal.note: For big rocks under the house on designed land. Equipment, operator time, hauling and dump fees. Blasting or very hard basalt can exceed high. Full price: usually hired out as a whole job.
rock-removal.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

utility-trench.label: Utility trenching
utility-trench.source: Judgment based on Boise excavation sub pricing
utility-trench.note: Trench, bedding sand, backfill. Excludes the pipe/conduit itself (in water-service / electrical-service). Rock trenching much higher. Full price: usually hired out as a whole job.
utility-trench.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

slab.label: Concrete slab floor (4 in, gravel, vapor barrier)
slab.source: HomeGuide concrete slab cost (4" slab $6-$8 installed; gravel base $1-$3/sqft)
slab.note: Includes 4 in gravel base, 10-15 mil vapor barrier, rebar/mesh. Excludes footings. Split ~54/46 per HomeGuide materials 50-60%.
slab.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

footing.label: Continuous footing
footing.source: Judgment based on typical 20x10 in footing with 2-3 #4 bars (~0.06 cuyd/ft) at Boise ready-mix pricing plus forming labor
footing.note: Formed, reinforced, poured. Wider frost/engineered footings higher. Idaho frost depth 24 in in Ada County.
footing.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

stem-wall.label: Crawlspace stem wall
stem-wall.source: HomeGuide foundation cost (stem wall $6-$18; poured walls $15-$40/sqft); Boise stem-wall crawlspaces are the regional norm
stem-wall.note: Per sqft of wall face, 8 in poured, reinforced, anchor bolts. Split ~40/60.
stem-wall.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

basement-wall.label: Basement wall 8" poured concrete
basement-wall.note: Per sqft of wall face, 8-9 ft tall, reinforced. Excludes footing, waterproofing, excavation. Split ~40/60.
basement-wall.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

waterproofing.label: Below-grade waterproofing
waterproofing.source: Judgment based on exterior membrane/drainage-board pricing; HomeGuide gives only whole-house totals ($10k-$18k exterior)
waterproofing.note: Spray/roll membrane + dimple drainage board on exterior of basement walls. Dampproofing only would be ~half.
waterproofing.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

window-well.label: Egress window well with ladder
window-well.source: HomeGuide window well line items: steel well $400-800, egress ladder $100-300, labor $400-1,400+ (about $1,000-3,000 installed, $2,000 typical). US numbers; Boise-specific data wasn't found.
window-well.note: Each well: galvanized well, ladder, gravel, digging and backfill. Not the window or cutting the foundation wall. Ballpark: confirm with local bids.
window-well.normalized: Already a US-average figure; not divided by Boise's cost level.

garage-slab.label: Garage slab
garage-slab.note: 4 in reinforced slab on gravel, sloped to door, no vapor barrier needed. Slightly cheaper than house slab.
garage-slab.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

floor-framing.label: Floor framing (joists + subfloor)
floor-framing.source: Judgment based on HomeGuide framing ($4-$17/sqft material, $7-$13 labor for whole-house framing) scaled to floor system only
floor-framing.note: I-joists or 2x10/2x12 at 16 in o.c., rim, 3/4 in T&G OSB subfloor glued/screwed, beams/posts. Per sqft of floor.
floor-framing.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

ext-wall-framing.label: Outside wall framing (2x6, sheathing, house wrap)
ext-wall-framing.source: HomeGuide cost to frame a house (sheathing $1-$3.50/sqft installed) + judgment
ext-wall-framing.note: Per sqft of exterior wall area (gross). 2x6 @16 in, headers, 7/16 OSB, housewrap. Lumber prices 2026 assumed near 2024-25 levels. Lowered by about 25% after checking whole-house totals against published Boise cost per sq ft.
ext-wall-framing.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

ext-wall-framing-2x4.label: Outside wall framing (2x4, sheathing, house wrap)
ext-wall-framing-2x4.source: Claude's estimate: the 2x6 rate less about 12.5% for the smaller studs and plates (sheathing, wrap and headers stay the same)
ext-wall-framing-2x4.note: Per sqft of exterior wall area (gross). 2x4 @16 in, headers, 7/16 OSB, housewrap. Only used when the plan basics say 2x4 outside walls.
ext-wall-framing-2x4.normalized: Worked out from the US-average 2x6 rate.

int-wall-framing.label: Inside wall framing
int-wall-framing.source: HomeGuide (basement wall framing $18-$24/lf) adjusted up for 9 ft walls, headers, blocking
int-wall-framing.note: 2x4 @16 in, double top plate, headers at openings.
int-wall-framing.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

curved-wall-framing.label: Curved walls: extra framing
curved-wall-framing.source: Judgment: no published curved-wall price; extra on top of straight framing for kerfed or bent plates and layout (about 1.5x to 2.5x the straight labor), from HomeAdvisor wall-install baselines
curved-wall-framing.note: Extra cost per foot of curved wall along the curve, added to the straight-wall rates. Ballpark: confirm with local bids.
curved-wall-framing.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

roof-framing.label: Roof framing (trusses + sheathing)
roof-framing.note: Per sqft of roof surface. Engineered trusses, 7/16-1/2 in OSB sheathing, crane set. Stick-framed vaulted roofs toward high. Lowered by about 25% after checking whole-house totals against published Boise cost per sq ft.
roof-framing.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

stairs.label: Stairs (one straight flight, finished)
stairs.source: Judgment based on stair-builder pricing for site-framed stringers with oak/maple treads, painted risers, simple rail
stairs.note: One 13-14 riser straight run with a wall-mounted handrail (included here); open-side guards and half walls along the stairs are priced separately as Stair railings.
stairs.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

deck.label: Deck (pressure-treated frame, composite boards)
deck.source: Judgment based on national deck cost guides ($30-$60/sqft installed for composite)
deck.note: Includes footings, framing, decking and a simple railing.
deck.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

overhang-post.label: Post and footing under a room on posts
overhang-post.source: Judgment based on a 6x6 treated post, post base and cap, and a 24 in square pier footing at Boise ready-mix pricing plus labor
overhang-post.note: Each post with its footing, below the frost line (24 in in Ada County).
overhang-post.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

overhang-beam.label: Beam under a room on posts
overhang-beam.source: Judgment based on built-up 2x12 or 3.5x11.25 LVL beam pricing at Boise lumber yards plus framing labor
overhang-beam.note: For a room on an upper floor held up by posts and a beam. An engineer sizes the real beam.
overhang-beam.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

roof-shingle.label: Architectural asphalt shingle roof
roof-shingle.source: HomeGuide asphalt shingle roof cost (architectural $4-$6/sqft installed, material $1-$2.50)
roof-shingle.note: Includes synthetic underlayment, ice & water at eaves/valleys, drip edge, flashing, ridge vent. New construction (no tear-off) priced at or slightly below replacement figures.
roof-shingle.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

roof-flat.label: Flat roof (TPO membrane)
roof-flat.source: Judgment based on national TPO cost guides ($8-$15/sqft installed for small residential areas)
roof-flat.note: 60 mil TPO over tapered insulation and cover board. Small residential areas carry a minimum charge.
roof-flat.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

roof-hip-valley.label: Extra roofing work at hips and valleys
roof-hip-valley.source: Judgment based on roofer cut/flash waste allowances
roof-hip-valley.note: Extra for valley metal, ice & water, cut waste and hip/ridge cap beyond a simple gable.
roof-hip-valley.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

gutters.label: Seamless aluminum gutters + downspouts
gutters.source: Judgment based on national gutter cost guides (5-6 in seamless aluminum $9-$18/lf installed)
gutters.note: 5 in K-style .027 aluminum, downspouts included in per-lf price. Split ~35/65 as roll-formed on site.
gutters.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

window.label: Windows (mid-range vinyl/fiberglass)
window.source: HomeGuide vinyl windows cost ($250-$1,000 material, $100-$500 labor per window) converted to per-sqft for Andersen 100 / Pella Impervia class
window.note: Per sqft of rough opening. Assumes ~15 sqft avg window; new-construction flange install is cheaper than replacement. Low-E double-pane, U~0.27-0.30 (Idaho energy code).
window.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

patio-door.label: Sliding patio door (6 ft)
patio-door.source: Judgment based on Andersen 100/Pella Impervia/Milgard Tuscany retail pricing + install
patio-door.note: 6 ft vinyl/composite slider with screen, flashed and trimmed.
patio-door.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

entry-door.label: Entry door (fiberglass/steel + lockset)
entry-door.source: Judgment based on Therma-Tru/Masonite fiberglass retail pricing + install
entry-door.note: 36 in prehung fiberglass with glass lite option, mid-range handleset/deadbolt. Sidelites push to high.
entry-door.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

interior-door.label: Interior door (prehung shaker)
interior-door.source: Judgment based on big-box/lumberyard prehung pricing + finish carpenter rates
interior-door.note: Solid-core molded shaker prehung, hinges, passage/privacy lever. Paint in interior-paint.
interior-door.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

pocket-door.label: Pocket door
pocket-door.source: Judgment based on pocket frame kit + slab + hardware pricing
pocket-door.note: Johnson/ similar frame kit, solid-core slab, pocket pull hardware.
pocket-door.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

barn-door.label: Barn door
barn-door.source: Judgment based on retail barn door slab + track kit pricing
barn-door.note: Shaker slab + steel track kit, wall blocking.
barn-door.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

garage-door.label: Garage door (insulated steel + opener)
garage-door.source: Judgment based on Boise garage door dealer typical pricing (16x7 insulated steel w/ opener ~$3,000-$4,500)
garage-door.note: Per linear foot of door width. Includes belt-drive opener. Carriage-style/glass toward high.
garage-door.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

siding.label: Fiber cement siding (painted)
siding.source: HomeGuide Hardie board siding cost ($18-$30/sqft replacement incl tear-off, labor 50-65%) adjusted down for new construction
siding.note: Per sqft of wall. HardiePlank lap or panel + battens, primed and field-painted (or ColorPlus). New construction skips tear-off/prep, so well below HomeGuide replacement range. Lowered by about 25% after checking whole-house totals against published Boise cost per sq ft.
siding.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

ext-trim.label: Exterior trim (soffit, fascia, corners)
ext-trim.source: Judgment based on fiber cement/aluminum soffit-fascia pricing per lf of perimeter
ext-trim.note: Per linear foot of building perimeter. Vented soffit, fascia, corner boards, window trim allowance, paint. Lowered by about 25% after checking whole-house totals against published Boise cost per sq ft.
ext-trim.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

wall-insulation.label: Wall insulation R-21
wall-insulation.source: Judgment based on insulation sub pricing (R-21 batts $1.40-$2.80/sqft installed)
wall-insulation.note: Per sqft exterior wall. Fiberglass batts or BIBS; includes air sealing basics. Spray foam would be 2-3x.
wall-insulation.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

wall-insulation-2x4.label: Wall insulation R-13 + R-5 foam
wall-insulation-2x4.source: Claude's estimate: R-13 batts (about $0.50-$0.80/sqft) plus 1 in rigid foam board outside the sheathing (about $0.80-$1.60/sqft), materials
wall-insulation-2x4.note: Per sqft exterior wall. 2x4 walls need R-5 continuous foam on the outside to meet the energy code (13+5), as the energy sheet says.

attic-insulation.label: Attic insulation R-49 blown
attic-insulation.source: Judgment based on insulation sub pricing
attic-insulation.note: Per sqft of ceiling, blown fiberglass/cellulose ~14-16 in, baffles.
attic-insulation.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

drywall.label: Drywall (hang, tape, texture)
drywall.source: HomeGuide drywall installation cost ($1.50-$3.50/sqft hang+finish; texture +$0.80-$2.00)
drywall.note: Per sqft of wall+ceiling surface. 1/2 in walls, 5/8 ceilings/garage firewall, Level 4, orange peel/knockdown typical in Boise.
drywall.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

curved-wall-drywall.label: Curved walls: extra drywall
curved-wall-drywall.source: Judgment: no published curved-wall price; thin 1/4 in or 3/8 in flexible board, often two layers, plus slower labor, from HomeGuide drywall baselines
curved-wall-drywall.note: Extra cost per foot of curved wall along the curve (both faces), added to the straight drywall rate. Ballpark: confirm with local bids.
curved-wall-drywall.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

plumbing-fixture-rough.label: Plumbing lines per fixture
plumbing-fixture-rough.source: Judgment based on plumber per-fixture pricing in new construction (whole-house plumbing typically $15k-$30k for 2,400 sqft)
plumbing-fixture-rough.note: Supply (PEX), DWV, venting, gas piping share, and setting the fixture. Fixtures themselves in toilet/sink/shower lines.
plumbing-fixture-rough.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

water-heater.label: Water heater
water-heater.source: Judgment based on retail 50 gal gas / tankless pricing + install
water-heater.note: 50 gal gas power-vent tank at low/likely; gas tankless or heat-pump water heater at high.
water-heater.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

water-service.label: Water service line to house
water-service.source: Judgment based on Veolia tariff (customer installs line from meter box to house) + plumber pricing
water-service.note: 1 in PEX/poly from meter box to house, ~50-120 ft, incl. trench. Veolia furnishes and installs meter; customer owns meter-to-house line. Full price: usually hired out as a whole job.
water-service.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

electrical.label: Electrical (rough, devices, recessed lights)
electrical.source: HomeGuide electrical wiring cost (new construction $4-$9/sqft) plus mid-range lighting allowance
electrical.note: Per sqft finished floor. Includes AFCI/GFCI devices, low-voltage prewire basics and recessed lights. Decorative light fixtures are their own line (lighting-fixtures) since milestone 9.
electrical.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

electrical-service.label: Electrical panel and service (200 amp)
electrical-service.source: Judgment based on HomeGuide panel ($850-$2,500) and upgrade ($1,400-$2,800) figures plus underground service lateral
electrical-service.note: 200A meter-main, panel, grounding, ~50-100 ft underground conductor. Idaho Power line-extension charges (if any) excluded.
electrical-service.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

lighting-fixtures.label: Light fixtures (mid-range)
lighting-fixtures.source: Judgment: mid-range pendants, flush mounts and vanity lights at Home Depot/Lowe's run about $60-$300; electrician hangs one in about an hour
lighting-fixtures.note: Each decorative ceiling or wall light (pendants, chandeliers, vanity lights, flush mounts). Moved out of the electrical rate in milestone 9 (about $1.20/sqft taken off electrical).
lighting-fixtures.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

hvac.label: Heating and cooling (furnace, AC or heat pump, ducts)
hvac.source: Judgment based on Boise new-construction HVAC bids; HomeGuide's $1.75-$2.50/sqft new-construction figure is far below current local practice
hvac.note: Per sqft conditioned. 96% gas furnace + 2.5-4 ton AC or cold-climate heat pump, sealed ductwork, bath/kitchen exhaust, ERV not included. Boise: 5,700+ HDD and hot dry summers.
hvac.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

flooring.label: Flooring (blended LVP/carpet/eng. wood)
flooring.source: Judgment based on blended mid-range LVP ($6-$9 inst), carpet ($4-$7), engineered wood ($9-$14) allowance
flooring.note: Per sqft of floor that gets these finishes (excl. tiled areas). Mix ~60% LVP/hard, 40% carpet.
flooring.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

tile.label: Tile (floors + shower walls)
tile.source: Judgment based on tile installer pricing in Boise, porcelain mid-range
tile.note: Porcelain tile on backer/membrane (Schluter-type for showers), grout, trim.
tile.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

interior-paint.label: Interior paint
interior-paint.source: Judgment based on new-construction paint sub pricing per sqft of floor
interior-paint.note: Per sqft of floor area: walls, ceilings, doors and trim, 1 prime + 2 finish coats.
interior-paint.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

trim-millwork.label: Trim, closet shelves and millwork
trim-millwork.source: Judgment based on finish carpentry package pricing per sqft of floor
trim-millwork.note: MDF/paint-grade baseboard and casing, window sills/returns, wire or melamine closet shelving.
trim-millwork.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

kitchen-cabinets.label: Kitchen cabinets (mid-range)
kitchen-cabinets.source: HomeGuide kitchen cabinets cost (semi-custom $150-$700/lf installed; install $75-$150/lf)
kitchen-cabinets.note: Per linear foot of run with base + uppers (semi-custom, plywood boxes, soft-close). Islands count by base length.
kitchen-cabinets.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

countertops.label: Quartz countertops
countertops.source: HomeGuide quartz countertops cost (mid-quality $75-$110/sqft installed; labor $10-$30)
countertops.note: Mid-range quartz, eased edge, undermount sink cutout. Backsplash separate (tile).
countertops.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

cabinet-hardware.label: Cabinet pulls and knobs
cabinet-hardware.source: Judgment: mid-range pulls (Amerock, Liberty) run about $3-$18 each; installer time a few minutes each
cabinet-hardware.note: About 1.5 per linear foot of kitchen cabinets and 4 per bath vanity.
cabinet-hardware.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

vanity.label: Bath vanity with top
vanity.source: Judgment based on retail/semi-custom vanity pricing
vanity.note: 36-48 in vanity with quartz/cultured top and undermount sink(s) included; faucet in bath-sink-faucet.
vanity.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

toilet.label: Toilet
toilet.source: Judgment based on retail pricing (Toto/Kohler/American Standard mid-line) + set
toilet.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

bath-sink-faucet.label: Bath faucet + drain
bath-sink-faucet.source: Judgment based on retail Moen/Delta mid-line pricing
bath-sink-faucet.note: Faucet, pop-up drain, supplies. Sink bowl included with vanity top.
bath-sink-faucet.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

shower-tub.label: Tub or shower pan, valve body and glass
shower-tub.source: Judgment based on retail tub/pan + valve pricing
shower-tub.note: Alloy/acrylic tub or shower pan, pressure-balance valve body, glass door/curtain rod allowance: 70% of the old 'tub/shower or shower' line (trim is its own line). Tile walls in 'tile'.
shower-tub.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

tub-shower-trim.label: Tub and shower trim (spout, handles, shower head)
tub-shower-trim.source: Judgment based on retail tub/pan + valve pricing
tub-shower-trim.note: Spout, handle(s) and shower head for one tub or shower: 30% of the old 'tub/shower or shower' line. Product picks in Interior design replace it.
tub-shower-trim.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

kitchen-sink-faucet.label: Kitchen sink + faucet
kitchen-sink-faucet.note: Stainless undermount or composite sink, pull-down faucet, disposal.
kitchen-sink-faucet.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

appliance-package.label: Appliance package (mid-range)
appliance-package.source: Judgment based on retail pricing for mid-range Whirlpool/GE/LG/Bosch suites
appliance-package.note: Range (gas or induction), fridge, dishwasher, microwave, vented hood.
appliance-package.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

laundry-hookup.label: Laundry hookup
laundry-hookup.note: Washer box, drain, 240V dryer circuit or gas stub, dryer vent run. Appliances not included.
laundry-hookup.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

sewer-connection.label: Boise sewer connection fee
sewer-connection.source: City of Boise Public Works connection fee memo (treatment + trunk fees phased in FY2025-FY2027)
sewer-connection.note: Fees only. FY2027 (from 10/1/2026) estimate: $5,133 for 701-2,100 sqft low-density SFR; >2,800 sqft ~$7,357; 'likely' interpolated for ~2,400 sqft. High includes a sewer assessment fee for lots never previously assessed. Lateral install is in utility-trench/plumbing. FY2027 numbers were 'estimates to be re-evaluated' in the memo; verify with Boise Sewer Rating 208-608-7150.
sewer-connection.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

water-connection.label: Veolia water connection
water-connection.source: Veolia Water Idaho tariff on file with Idaho PUC (eff. 6/1/2025)
water-connection.note: Tariff shows no tap/meter hookup fee for a lot fronting an existing main: Veolia furnishes meter and service to meter box; connection in business hours is free. Cost arises only when a main extension is needed (applicant deposits cost minus $500 free footage). Low=$0 subdivision lot; likely=small allowance; high=short main extension. Judgment for likely/high.
water-connection.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

well.label: Well (200 to 300 ft, with pump)
well.source: Judgment based on askdoss Idaho well cost guide (Treasure Valley $30-$55/ft drilling, pump $800-$3,000) scaled to 200-300 ft with 6 in steel casing, pressure tank, wiring
well.note: Total ~$18k-$45k. Includes drilling, casing, seal, submersible pump, pressure tank, wire, pitless adapter, IDWR start card. Water treatment excluded. Full price: usually hired out as a whole job.
well.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

septic.label: Septic system (with health district permit)
septic.source: Judgment based on CDH fee page (new permit $1,070 incl. test hole, July 2026) + Ada County installer pricing; HomeGuide's national $3,500-$8,500 conventional range is low for new Idaho installs
septic.note: Standard gravity system, 1,000-1,250 gal tank, drainfield. CDH permit $1,070 included in material. Pressure/alternative systems (common on shallow-groundwater or rocky Ada County lots) run $25k-$45k. Full price: usually hired out as a whole job.
septic.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

impact-fees.label: Impact fees (roads, parks, fire, police)
impact-fees.source: City of Boise FY2026 impact fee schedule (eff. 10/1/2026); ACHD adopted single-area fee via BoiseDev
impact-fees.note: Within Boise city limits: fees scale by house size and planning area, +1% surcharge. 2,101-2,800 sqft: regional parks $2,296.88 + local parks $0-$6,683.62 (West Bench $5,900.55) + fire $2,744.50 + police $715.14. ACHD $5,803/SFR (eff. 3/1/2026, https://boisedev.com/news/2025/12/08/achd-impact-fees-raise-errors-one-service-area/). Low = ~1,500-2,100 sqft in Airport/Downtown (no local parks fee); likely = 2,400 sqft West Bench; high = >2,800 sqft South. Area of City Impact (unincorporated) is only ~$1,179 parks + ACHD. Other cities (Meridian, Eagle) differ.
impact-fees.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

trade-permits.label: Electrical, plumbing and mechanical permits
trade-permits.source: Boise City plumbing, electrical (7/17/19) and mechanical (10/1/21) code fee schedules
trade-permits.note: Flat per-dwelling by sqft: plumbing $180 (1,501-2,500) / $250 (2,501-3,500); mechanical same; electrical $135 (<=2,500) / $155. ~$495-$655 for 1,500-3,500 sqft. Schedules are several years old; range padded for updates. Electrical: https://www.cityofboise.org/media/8322/final-electrical-code-fee-schedule-7-17-19.pdf ; Mechanical: https://www.cityofboise.org/media/8323/final-mechanical-code-and-fuel-gas-code-fee-schedule-10-1-21.pdf
trade-permits.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

roof-metal.label: Standing-seam metal roof
roof-metal.source: Roof Observations standing seam cost guide 2026 (steel $12.75/sq ft basic, $15.90 Kynar, installed)
roof-metal.note: Painted steel panels with clips, underlayment, trim and flashing. Used when a metal roof is picked.
roof-metal.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

siding-stucco.label: Stucco (three-coat)

siding-stucco.note: Lath, scratch, brown and finish coats over house wrap. Used when stucco siding is picked.
siding-stucco.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

siding-brick.label: Brick veneer
siding-brick.source: HomeServe stone veneer siding cost (citing HomeGuide: $10-$45/sq ft installed) and Bob Vila brick veneer notes

siding-brick.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

stone-veneer.label: Stone or thin brick veneer

stone-veneer.note: Manufactured stone or thin brick over lath and scratch coat. Used for a stone or brick accent.

pavers.label: Paver patio or walk
pavers.source: Bob Vila paver patio cost ($8-$25/sq ft installed, labor about half)
pavers.note: Concrete pavers on compacted gravel and sand with edge restraint. Used when pavers are picked for the patio or the front walk.
pavers.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

front-walk.label: Concrete front walk
front-walk.source: HomeGuide concrete slab cost (walkways about $6-$12/sq ft installed)

front-walk.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

lawn.label: Lawn (sod and sprinklers)
lawn.source: HomeServe sod installation cost (sod $0.31-$0.82/sq ft, install and soil prep $1-$2/sq ft); sprinkler parts are judgment
lawn.note: Soil prep, sod and an in-ground sprinkler system (needed in Boise's dry summers). The sod is about half the material; a seed or sod pick replaces that half.
lawn.normalized: Boise price divided by Boise's cost level (0.92) to give a US-average price.

planting-beds.label: Planting beds (mulch, edging, drip)
planting-beds.source: Judgment based on landscaping cost guides (mulch about $0.50-$1/sq ft installed, plus edging and drip lines)
planting-beds.note: Beds about 4 ft deep along the house: soil, edging, drip irrigation and 3 in of bark or rock mulch. A mulch pick replaces the mulch part (about 40%).

tall-cabinet.note: Each 84 in tall or pantry cabinet, on top of the run's base and upper cabinets.

stair-guard-wood.source: Estimate: HomeAdvisor national stair-railing ranges (wood $10-40/LF, metal $25-120/LF, glass $100-500/LF material) with installation labor, nudged up for stair complexity; Boise-specific data was thin (ContractorPlus modeled Boise railing average $30-59/LF). plan-review.label: Boise plan review fee
plan-review.source: Boise City Building Code Fee Schedule (10/1/23)
plan-review.note: One- and two-family dwellings: plan review charged at 20% of the building permit fee.

calibration.label: US-average new custom/semi-custom single-family home, mid-range finishes, materials only (plus permits, fees and the hired-out jobs), excluding land
calibration.source: Block Renovation Boise custom-home guide ($200-$350/sqft standard to mid-range; $400+ high-end); BuildIdaho Mar 2026 (Ada County luxury permit values $192-$345/sqft); judgment
calibration.note: Materials only: builder labor, overhead, profit and contingency are not included. Set from this file: the typical one-story houses in tests/cost.test.ts (a 3-bedroom and a larger one, no landscaping) come to about $138-139 per sq ft at Boise prices, so the Boise-level range is about $110-180, and this US-average range is that divided by 0.92. For comparison, building materials are usually about 40-55% of a full build cost. Replaces the earlier full-cost range ($234-370).
calibration.normalized: Boise-level range divided by Boise cost level (0.92).

permit.source: Typical fee table: 1997 UBC Table 1-A building permit fees (still used by many cities); building value from the ICC Building Valuation Data, Feb 2026, R-3 type V-B $175.92/sq ft times the place's cost level. Garage and porch values are scaled from Boise's ratios.
permit.note: A typical fee. Type your city's real fee in the box to replace it.

costLevelBase.source: PNNL/Faithful+Gould 2011 composite residential index (as used by the place list); not re-verified because the report's table could not be retrieved, and the paywalled RSMeans is not used

boise-id.source: Boise City Building Code Fee Schedule (eff. 10/1/2023, latest found) and Boise Residential Building Permit Valuation Policy (5/6/22)
boise-id.note: Boise values a new house at about $162 per sq ft of living space and $60 per sq ft of garage (ICC building valuation data times Boise's regional factor), then applies its fee table. Porches and decks use about $25 per sq ft (judgment; Boise's own figure for them wasn't published online).

note: Prices are materials only, except the hired-out jobs (marked hired: digging, grading, well, septic and the like), which are full price, and fees. Where a source line below mentions installed prices or labor, only the materials part is used.
